sections.title: Welcome to Coda!
sections.subtitle: We're so glad you're here.
sections.content: Hi there! You're in Coda! Now what? In a world where technology and tools are ever-evolving, docs have stayed the same with their generic interfaces and bland pages. Enter Coda. Here, your productivity possibilities are exponential. For now, let's start with the basics. Let's dive in!

sections.title: So, what is Coda?
sections.content: Coda is an all-in-one workspace that brings tools and teams together in one place for better collaboration, organization, project management, and productivity.

cta.text: Learn more about Coda

sections.title: Coda is a doc with pages.
sections.content: Docs are where your text and data live in one place. And within each Coda doc are pages, which you can find on the lefthand panel.

sections.title: Coda is also a table.
sections.content: Tables are used for dynamic views of key information. And speaking of dynamic, Coda tables update in real time—with no refresh needed.

sections.title: Coda is buttons.
sections.content: Buttons help you take action in a doc. There are tons of pre-built buttons (like a Gmail button that sends from your inbox), or you can build your own.

sections.title: Coda is automations.
sections.content: Automations allow Coda to work FOR you. Tell Coda the conditions you need to be met, then give it a set of actions to take, like sending a Slack notification or assigning a task.

sections.title: Coda is Packs.
sections.content: Packs are integrations that connect your favorite apps to Coda. Pull in data from Google Calendar, Slack, Figma, and hundreds of other tools to create a unified workspace.

sections.title: Transform your workflow.
sections.content: Coda docs have endless features to centralize information and build collaboration. Docs grow and evolve—taking in new information and data from your trusted sources.

sections.title: "I'm actually more of a visual learner..."
sections.content: We're big on collaboration here at Coda—both in and out of the doc. That's why we've curated interactive trainings to help you learn more about Coda and how to utilize its potential from the get-go. Sign up to join the next session or browse our list of webinars.
Ready to dive in? Coda has tons of templates to help you get started. Or start from scratch and build exactly what you need.
